title: Great shampoo and conditioner!
text:
This is an excellent shampoo and conditioner set. It's nearly perfect. I'm putting this at a 4.5. Now I don't know if this is just my hair being obnoxiously dry or not but that would be the only thing that I could say anything remotely "bad" about. The conditioning was just not quite enough on the ends of my hair. Great on the already healthy stuff, just seemed to ignore the drier ends. Figured I'd get that over with and move on to the good stuff.
This really gave my hair a nice shine to it. My hair is getting old with me and it no longer wants to be as manageable and tame as it once was. With this duo of delight my hair looked healthy after it dried. It looked good when left to air dry, when dried with the hot air brush, and when left to air dry. It looked shiny without the added matching shine spray (which is also a wonderful product) and with. I left out the word smooth in this so far but let me tell you! It was also smooth and sleek without having to use other products to make it stay that way. Granted, under all that grey old hair there has always been fairly thin straight hair so this just really put it back to looking like it used to in that regard. The shampoo cleaned it to the point of being squeaky clean as well.
Give this duet a try if you can. It works really well and smells alright to boot!

text:
Based on the low price of this item (actually two items, they come in a set of two) I'd give five stars.
But if I'm rating based only on its intrinsic quality and usefulness, I'd still give four stars.
I wanted a refillable powder container for my vanity. So I do not have any need to put this in my purse or makeup bag.
This compact/container is easy to fill. The sifter insert pops out easily too.
The plastic it's made from feels a little brittle and cheap, but I've had mine for several weeks and it's not cracked or broken.
The little powder puff is pretty tiny and almost useless, but it's a nice touch.
My biggest issue is the threading, when you screw the top on. The threads are just not good quality and it doesn't seem to screw together easily or securely. On my vanity, that's not a huge issue. But if you're intending to use this for travel, I'd recommend a different product OR keep this in a ziploc baggie!
So far, I'd recommend this for home use, and I would repurchase if needed.

title: I like this heated eye mask
text:
I like this heated eye mask, for the most part, I especially like that it exists in the first place! I was searching Amazon up and down for a heated eye mask that can be worn like a sleeping eye mask to relax my eye muscles after sitting at a computer all day when I finally came across this one. I don't care for the color or the kitty design, but the purple material is velvety soft which I do like.

The mask easily covers my head, though I do have a small head, and the strap fits around the back of my head pretty well. I do choose to wear my hair up at night when I use this heating mask otherwise the strap slides up my straight fine hair slowly if I move my head from side to side. And I somehow never wake up with it on, though I'm thinking that has much more to do with me removing it during the middle of the night vs a product error.

The power cord is composed of two pieces, the first has one end with a USB and the other as a round female piece. Connected to the mask on the right side is the other piece of the cord. This piece has a male round piece and connects perfectly to the female piece. I imagine this design is intended to allow the cord connected to the mask to easily be pulled out if the person moves during sleep.

I plug the cord right into my USB-hub with my phone charger and it works perfectly well.

The controls on this are odd, and you are provided zero instructions. There are two buttons I believe one is a (-) that is indented and the other is a (+) that is raised if my memory serves me right. You have to keep one side pressed down until the unit turns on, then I press the indented button because the numbers go up to 60 on this side. The numbers displaced are bizarre and I have no idea what unit of measurement they are - though degrees Celcius makes the most sense.

The one thing I wish this product had was sewn in contours for the nose and eye sockets so it was able to lay more flush with your eyes. This would allow your eyes to feel a more direct heat. Usually, to counterbalance this I place one of my arms over the heating mask to apply weight and increase the intensity of the heat.

title: Works great! Double beachy wave, Heatless curling system.
text: This works great! You just have to know how to use it correctly. The double curler band allows you to use less hair on each curler so that the hair dries faster and curls faster. Here IS MY 2 HOURS TO PRETTY CURLS METHOD: Part upper hair at crown of head,  and put hair from the upper head at crown,  in a pony tail for later. Snap the curling system closed, so that there is 2 round circle bands to use to curl with, and put both around head like a double crown head band. Push the top curling band where pont tail is for later use. Separate the bottom layer of hair into two parts... left side and right side and use only the bottom circle band curler for the bottom portion of head. Begin curling in left side by spritzing a little water onto the hair at root and curl it under band tucking it under and around curler one time only and then in next pass, grab a little more hair with it and continue going around the curler band. Keep spritzing new hair with water each time you pick up a new piece of hair and add that hair to the previous end of the one you just curled, until the whole left, bottom  side is done. Then start on the bottom right side of hair. When finished,  the  whole bottom curling band  will be filled with the hair from the lower portion of. Now it's time to take out the pony tail that was  on the grown of head  and put that hair under the second curling band and separate the left side of hair from the right. Start curling the left upper part of head as you did the bottom portion... spritzing small portion of hair with water at root and curling it once around the band and then pick up a little more new hair, spritz it with water and curl together with the former portion around band until all left side is done and now do right side. DO NOT SOAK HAIR.  Only LIGHTLY MIST IT a little with water or it wont dry in 2 hours. Dont curl too big a portion of hair at a time either, or it won't dry in two hours. Wait about 1 hour to 2 hours and remove curlers and you will get beachy type ringlets that are big. It takes about 10 minutes to wind hair around curlers. Lovely curls.

title: Look great, easy to apply, hard to remove
text:
I'm a false eyelash beginner and I have to say that magnetic lashes are far easier to apply, in my opinion, because the magnetic pull as you get the lashes close to their intended destination help you place them properly. They also seem to be a little more forgiving than traditional adhesive lashes if you need to slightly reposition them. This set has a great variety of styles and lengths and comes with two tubes of magnetic liner and a pair of eyelash calipers to help set them in place. If you're just starting out with lashes, this is a great way to do it.

However, there are some downsides. First, I find the eyeliner extremely irritating to my eyes (and my nose, as it is heavily scented). It is also really difficult to remove (I have to soak my eyelids with Bi-Facil on a cotton pad at least twice and then follow up with micellar water and MAYBE that will get all of it off). Be prepared to soak your lashes, because that's the only way this stuff is coming off. Second, I find the lashes somewhat uncomfortable. They feel heavier on the lid than adhesive lashes and I can often feel the metal on the band. I tend to remove these long before I remove a pair of adhesive lashes because I am never NOT aware of them on my lids. Third, if you use a tweezer/caliper thing to place your lashes, do yourself a favor and just buy a decent one. This one is plastic and has no tension, so you have to manually open it to fix the lashes in it, then fiddle with it again to take it away from the lashes. For me this was a bonus, because I got so frustrated with it, I just learned to do it with my hands with much better results.

Despite my problems with this set, I would totally recommend trying this out to see if magnetic lashes are for you. The variety of styles will give you a lot of options to experiment with different looks, but do take care of your eyelids and make sure you have appropriate product to remove the tenacious eyeliner. Happy lashing!

title: Good product, excellent customer service!
text:
I'm not new to hair extensions. I've worn them for a few years quite a while ago when growing out a short cut. Once again, I went a little balayage bleach crazy and fried my longer hair which caused a ton of my length to break off. I decided to go this route again while growing my length back out. I have fine hair, but a lot of it, so I got 2 packs. I could probably use a few more for fullness but 20 sets looks fine. My hair is currently color treated dark red at the roots and the color fades to magenta at the ends. I got the light brown to blonde extensions so I could custom dye them to match. The extensions took the dye very well and you can't tell a color difference between my hair and the extensions at all.

The claim that they are thick from root to tip isn't true. Most extensions claim this though and I expected it, so I got longer hair than I really wanted so I could trim it and get rid of the thinning in the ends. I've had minimal shedding so all in all, that is a plus.

They come super straight out of the pack but have some natural wave to them when you wash them. Not a problem as my natural hair does too so they blend well there too. They are soft and as long as you use a leave in oil they will stay frizz free. They hold curl really well too. I curled them and they stayed curled over two days, long after the curl fell out of my natural hair. I've had some tapes separate after install, and removed some due to my own misplacement, but replaced them with tape I had before. Most of the original tape has been replaced at this point so I can't speak to its quality or longevity.

I'm not totally blown away but am happy enough with my purchase to wear them until it's time to replace them.

Edit 6/7/21: I was contacted by Easyouth customer service because my review wasnt a 100% satisfied review. They offered to send me a free pack and provide a discount code for my next purchase to update my review. I will say that they have gone above and beyond what I would expect from a seller. Given I wasnt disappointed in the product, but had a similar experience to what I'm used to from other experiences with extensions. They were very responsive, very quickly. That's something I appreciate.

The new pack I was sent was packaged differently than the two packs I ordered. They came in a branded cardboard box. The extensions were packaged nicely in a plastic sleeve and inside the sleeve the wefts were attached to a thinner paper card and tucked into a little hair net to keep them from tangling. (My first order was just attached to a long, thick paper sleeve.) The hair is still beautiful. I also ordered a halo using the code I was provided. So I plan to dye all of my new extensions to match my natural hair once it arrives.

Thanks for the great product and excellent customer service!

title: A Very Rich Oil. Organic And Cold Pressed.
text:
I have only been using this oil for about three weeks, so I don't yet have any long-term or miraculous results to report. However, I do enjoy using the oil and have found it to be of very fine quality. When I received the oil I was pleased to see that it is cold pressed, so no chemical extraction processes are used.

This oil is quite rich in texture compared to other oils you may be using on your body such as jojoba or sesame. It's less oily than other oils, so it doesn't spread over your skin as easily. The best way to use it is to dampen your skin before use. That way it's easier to rub in and more easily absorbed. It also helps you use less oil, and thus save a little money.

So far I've been primarily using the oil on my face, as middle-age dryness calls for rich moisture. What I really like about this oil is that if I use it after a shower in the evening, my face still feels smooth and soft when I wake up in the morning.

If you're familiar with other rich, cold-pressed botanical oils such as extra-virgin olive oil, you know they have a distinctive smell. Not unpleasant, just very rich is the only way I can describe it. This oil does not smell like olive oil, but it does have its own smell. It is made from rose hip seeds, so don't expect it to smell like roses.

For now I give this oil four stars, to be upgraded in the future if I experience any exceptional results after continued use. A sample bottle was provided to me for review.

text: This coffee scrub smells divine while dry, and leaves my skin smelling ever so subtly like coffee and cinnamon.  Oddly, I don’t really notice the smell in the shower.  I love the exfoliation and use it on my entire body.  Out of the shower, I feel a mild oil barrier on my skin that I don’t care for.  Once I add my normal body shaping cream (Clarins Body Fit), I’m in heaven!  The 2 products together leave my skin super cool and tingly for about an hour, followed by crazy soft skin.  I don’t actually have a lot of cellulite (thank you Clarins!), but what I do have is less noticeable after just 2 uses.  So, what’s not to like?  This scrub is so incredibly messy, it’s borderline impractical!  Most scrubs are made with sugar or salt crystals held together with some form of oil or gel, and dissolve in the shower.  Ground coffee doesn’t dissolve and this scrub is dry, so it literally gets everywhere...like sand from the beach!  And worse, I have a walk in shower with white tile floors...coffee stains if it sits too long!  As much as I like the way this product smells and improves my skin texture, it’s a pain in my cellulite free backside to clean up!  Mixing it with a little water and creating a paste before use helps a little, and thankfully I have a handheld shower to quickly rinse it off my tiled walls and shower door, but I’m constantly concerned it’s going to stain my floor grout.  Deep sigh...I soooooo wish this product weren’t so messy!

title: Good trims, flimsy parts
text:
I read all the reviews and decided to take a chance, based on the past good performance of an older Norelco trimmer.

The good news is that this trimmer works as well as the old Norelco and its small mustache trimmer attachment is much better than the one-size-fits-all blade of earlier models.

The charging and battery indicator systems are also very much improved.

The vacuum feature, which I did not expect to be perfect, is adequate, but as others have said, don't buy just for that. It appears to catch more than half the mess, which is helpful.

My only complaint is the parts you need to work with every time you use the trimmer. The detachable comb/accu-trim guide is not flimsy per se, but the tracks it fits into are and it requires careful attention to align it properly to put it back on the trimmer. I fear that one of these days I may put it on outside the track and snap the plastic runners that go into the tracks.

The internal pieces of the cutter mechanisms -- main and mustache trimmer -- are downright flimsy. The first time I removed the main blade it felt like something snapped, but I couldn't see anything wrong. When I put it back on after using the mustache trimmer, the device ran at about half RPM and sounded like it was straining. Sure enough, the force required to remove the main blade had resulted in its inner row of teeth coming out of the little track it runs in, back and forth, to cut hair, and I had to play jeweler as I squinted to carefully coax it back into place.

Not having owned any other brand, I don't know if they cut any better -- I doubt it. But the older Norelco was less fragile.

I plan to keep this one, unless it breaks during the 60-day trial. If I could rate it at 3.5 stars I would.

UPDATE Feb. 21: nothing has broken; the "problem" parts are wearing in so they come apart much more easily and I am definitely going to keep this trimmer.

title: cat LOVES the brush, but hated it initially..
text:
When I first opened this brush I was very excited to see how my spoiled cat would like a nice brushing with it. I pulled it out of the package and showed it to him as he needs to inspect everything before he will allow it near him. He unfortunately ran away as soon as he got one sniff! I was puzzled, but I quickly realized that the silicone was not smelling great. That sometimes happens with new silicone and it just needs to sit out for a few days to have the smell dissipate. In a couple days the smell went away and I gave the brush another try. At first my cat pulled away because he remembered the smell, but once he realized it didn't smell, he let me give him a pet. He generally likes gentle petting, but this brush by nature makes even the most gentle brushing a little more rough. He accepted the new level of brushing and I proceeded to brush him. I was immediately amazed at the amount of cat hair this brush was removing per brush. This hands down is the most efficient cat brush I have ever used! I had to clean the bristles every few strokes, which is very simple to do by peeling the hair off in one large section. My cat is a short hair and does not shed very much at all, so I was confused as to how so much hair was being removed from my cat. He was in heaven so I kept on going until each section I was brushing would not brush out any more hair. When he got up from brushing, the cat looked better to me. Maybe because all of the loose hair was no longer holding down his shiny Tuxedo hair. In all I took out a handful of hair from my 7 pound cat. His coat looks shinier, fluffier and healthier now because of a simple brushing.

One thing I do need to mention about this brush is that it is not the most comfortable thing to hold for long periods of time. I pet my cat for about 45 minutes and my hand was hurting from gripping the cube for so long.

I removed 1 star - for the initial smell and the uncomfortable hand grip.

title: 5 Drops Will Do Ya
text: This is a very nice hair serum that is targeted at encouraging and speeding up hair growth. The first ingredent, and therefore the  most prevalent ingredient, is a type of silicone. Silicone has become the most popular ingredient for anti-friz and shine serums for hair, not to mention a whole world of cosmetics like oil free moisturizers and foundations. It has a slip to it, which gives silicone the *feeling of being like an oil, but it is by its nature, is totally oil free. And of course, also by its nature, it cannot clog pores or follicles. Infact, the Dae Long Hair Growth Serum formula contains three different types of silicone as its first three ingredients. The active ingredients in the product, or the ingredients that actually enable the product to do its job of encouraging hair growth, are Jojoba Oil, Macadamia Nut Oil, Lupine Protein, and Panax Ginseng. These nourish and stimulate the hair follicles to remain longer in the anagen, or hair growing phase, and to produce healthier, stronger hair from the root. Jojoba oil is a skin compatible oil, meaning that it cannot and does not clog pores or follicles, closely resembles the body's own natural lubrication, and can be absorbed by human hair, skin, and nails. There is also extract of Macadamia Nut Oil, which moisturizes the hair cuticle and shaft and helps to prevent hair breakage and split ends. Hydrolyzed protein from the seeds of the lupine plant are very high in protein and contain 35-45% of all the essential amino acids. Panax ginseng is an extract from the panax ginger root and has nourishing and stimulating qualities that directly feed and nourish the hair follicle. I was fortunate to be able to order this product at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. I have used a great many hair serums and products to stimulate growth of stronger, longer, and healthier hair. One of my favorite things about this Dae Long Hair Growth Serum is that it has a very pleasant fragrance! I also really like that the ingredient list is simple, straightforward, and does not contain weird chemicals or scary preservatives!!! It has a very clean  feel to it, not leaving your hair greasy at the last part that you want to be greasy, the roots. A few drops goes a long way I say five drops will do. While pleasant, It is also important not to over do it!. I have very, very sensitive skin and had no problem at all with this. Time will tell how much it makes the hair grow. I am also taking a good hair, skin & nails vitamin because as a Licensed Esthetician, I know for a fact that you have to feed and nourish INSIDE AS WELL AS OUTSIDE in order to truly grow longer, stronger, and healthier hair!!

title: THE BEST!  Better than Super Blue, Glam Seamless Tape, and Satin Strands.  Try it!
text:
I have had tape-in extensions for several years and these are BY FAR the BEST replacement tapes I have used. I only use Glam Seamless extension hair and these fit those pieces really well. I love that these can easily be split in half because when I place my extensions I use a single piece and fold it in half, rather than sandwiching 2 pieces, to put less weight on my baby fine hair.

I have tried many types of replacement tapes including the "Super Blue", and in a pinch the super cheap (quality, not cost!) Satin Strands, and these far outshine them all. With all other tapes I always lose 1-2 pieces every time I wash my hair (which is only 1x/week), and the rest slip a little with each wash. So because of that I always put them in as close to the scalp as possible. To my surprise, not only did I not lose any with this tape, they didn't slip at all, not even a little! So I had nearly 2 weeks of my extensions remaining really tight to my head! I almost pulled them out because they were getting uncomfortable, but I ended up sticking it out.

It has now been just about 6 weeks and I am going to pull them out and reset them within the week. They still haven't slipped very much, and I still haven't lost a single one! By this point with any other tape, half of them would have come out by now! I could easily leave these in another month without much issue, but my baby fine hair knots easily when there is any outgrowth.

This tape is a little bit thicker than other tapes, which is likely why it holds so well. When putting the two pieces together, really press down and squish them together to ensure there is a secure contact with both sides. Then heat set the pieces between a hot iron on low for 5-10 seconds - this is not in the instructions but is recommended on the product's website, so I did it, and got really great results!

Because these have such a strong hold, I just ordered the C-22 solvent to remove them. I normally use coconut oil, but suspected I might need something a bit more to remove these. I will update my review once I remove them and share whether or not it was more difficult, compared to other tapes.

title: Colonoscopy Prep NECESSITY
text:
I recently had my first colonoscopy, and I had been warned that the prep was the worst part. Yeah, that was a total understatement. I am SO grateful to my mom, who told me to lay in a supply of this Balneol lotion to use when ... um ... tidying up after eliminating.

I will admit, I was skeptical. Lotion? For my BUM?! Turns out, that's a very definite YES.

If you've had a colonoscopy, you know that after you drink that concoction of vileness that they call the "prep drink," you're going to poop in much the same way that Vesuvius erupts. Trip after trip to the loo, right? Right. Oh, you thought you were done and could have a little lie-down to recover? Haha. NOPE! Why don't you just bring in War and Peace and sit here the rest of the day?

So after a few trips to the throne room, your bum feels a bit sore. Even the softest toilet tissue feels like 80-grit sandpaper rasping all the skin off your most delicate bits. And you can't stop going to the loo, because that death-potion you had to drink is ripping through you like a wildfire through a summer-dry grassland. In fact, your bum feels like it might BE on fire.

That's where this lotion stuff comes in. After gently patting the worst of the debris off your bum, you take a fresh piece of toilet roll and put a bit of this stuff on it. Use that to clean up the rest of you. The relief is instant, like a cup of ice-water after a mid-day hike through Death Valley in mid-August. And it does seem to make the cleanup more effective.

I imagine people with chronic digestive issues would also find this useful, and I know that on days when my "girl thing" is happening, it's a relief to clean up using this product. But if you're slated for a colonoscopy, you should most definitely lay in a supply of this stuff. You're gonna need it!

title: Good for those 6 to 60 ... and beyond
text:
When my son was 6 (1st grade), I started to notice that he would smell after school sometimes. We tried washing up in the morning in addition to night time bath but it didn't work consistently. Again, the odor was irregular but seemed to coincide on days he played or sweat more - PE day, extended recess, after school sports.

Not wanting him to be picked on but also not impact his young body, I looked for a gentle product or remedies that would help. We started using this only on those high-activity days only and he never had an issue. That worked great for a year and a half. Now nearly 8 y.o. he's started to use it daily in the morning with no issues. It does have a stronger fragrance than I would expect but no reactions and it smells pretty good - just kinda like putting men's cologne on, which is a but unexpected for a small child.

My mom (over 65) has had SEVERAL surgeries to remove lumps caused by harsh deodorants that contain aluminum. When she found out about this deodorant, she asked me to buy some for her and my 12 y.o cousin who had just undergone surgery like my mom has had. It worked fantastic for both.

I now have to buy this for my great uncle (90s), great aunt (80), cousin, mom and son. All of them love the line - the pink, purple or blue all seem to work well. I recently started trying it as well and it works for me also. I don't have reactions to aluminum-based deodorant but if it's not necessary, I may just switch completely.

It seems like the amount that you pay for what you get is a bit much but the deodorant seems to last quite a while. Plus, for my mom and cousin who have had no surgery since starting, it's a steal.

title: Super underrated fragrance house
text:
English Laundry is highly underrated. It's fine to call them what they are, they're a relatively cheapy house that makes fragrances that are often inspired by others, but they do it very well. I have more than a few of their scents and this is what you can expect of these four:

Notting Hill - This has what you might call a barbershop scent to it. A strong, clean musk, definitely some wood notes in there with a mix of cedar and sandalwood. I've heard it compared to Viking by Creed and I think that's not far off on the dry down, but the opening on Notting Hill has more citrus. Strongest scent of the bunch for sure.

Riveria - This is just a great, easily wearable blue fragrance. I gave mine another spray while I writing this just for the reminder. I was surprised when I first smelled this because this was THE scent from English Laundry that was hyped up. And I like it, no question, but it's very similar to other blue scents. It dries down powdery, has a hint of woodsy notes, but I mostly just get lavender and jasmine mixing with a bit of aquatic notes. That said, it's unbeatable at it's price and probably the easiest to wear in the bunch.

Oxford Bleu - So, when I first smelled this I thought "Oh that's just straight up Versace Eros." Having smelled them side by side since I own them both, it's still very similar, but a little different. Eros is more loud, Oxford Bleu has a lot of the same mint, vanilla, and apple that you'd get from Eros, but more subdued in the dry down. Again, for the price you can't go wrong here, it's an exceptional scent, but that's because Eros is an exceptional scent.

Arrogant - A disclaimer upfront: I think what's going on with Arrogant and me is all just my personal body chemistry. It's a sleeper hit for sure, it has a very clean, soapy, lavender feel to it that I love. The only problem is that unless I over spray, the scent dies on my skin really fast. It's not a complaint I've heard elsewhere, so this might just be me, but that gives it a disappointment mark or two. I went and put this on a tester strip as I was writing this and could barely smell it, so I put a couple of sprays on my skin, and sure, I definitely like it, but it's hard to pick up with normal use. I might just be nose blind to it, honestly. The closest scent I could place it with would be Le Male by John Paul Gaultier. Just a bit weaker.

All in all, English Laundry is not to be slept on, and there's no bad scents in this bunch.

title: Great serum that really works!
text:
We are all searching for the fountain of youth! Okay I don't want to look old and wrinkled! The description very much interested me so I decided I was ready to try it here!! I've never tried anything from the dead sea and when I read that the product was made within a few miles of the Dead Sea, with no mineral degradation during transport. I was anxious to give it a try. I try all sorts of things to keep that youthful glow of the skin but I also am selective about what I apply to my skin. Everything was natural here though, and It is not tested on animals, contains NO Alcohol, Sulfate or Parabens and is non- toxic.

The product came in a 1.1 fluid ounce moisturizing serum. This product contains Glycerin and essential Dead Sea Minerals, known for their exceptional hydroscopic attributes and as a source of beautifying minerals. I read that in the description and thought what in the world is hydroscopic...so I looked it up. "Hygroscopy (etymology and pronunciation) is the ability of a substance to attract and hold water molecules from the surrounding environment. This is achieved through either absorption or adsorption with the absorbing or adsorbing substance becoming physically changed somewhat." They perform synergistically (which means together with) Squalane, Dunaliella Salina Extract, Jojoba Seed Oil and Wheat Protein to help increase the skin's moister levels and diminish water loss for a more vital and glowing overall look. After reading that in the description and researching what some of the terms meant, I decided to put the product to the test. I have aging sking that is somewhat problematic with large pores and a few minor areas of sagging skin. I read clearly in the description that Genesea Perfecting Serum helps to disapate the signs of skin aging such as fine lines, wrinkles and sagginess and that you would see effects of the serum in five minutes.

I've been using the serum for a good while now sometimes under makeup and every night before going to bed at night on clean dry skin. The serum is of excellent quality with no redness, burning itching or negative side effects. It doesn't react against or burn the skin. I don't have a problem with it leaving my face greasy or shiny and it quickly absorbs into the skin within just a couple of minutes. I notice an immediate firming and suppleness of the skin but no discomfort or a feeling of being too taut. There is no build up or product residue left on the skin at all. This product has a nice smell, light and kind of floral smelling, but no bad smell at all. It is quite easy to use with an pump dispenser for the serum. I always prefer a pump dispenser as it keeps the integrity of the product by keeping air and contaminants out. A little of the serum goes a long way, and the product is lasting a good long time.

This product really hydrates my skin and make it look nice and firm almost immediately. This serum really works and is reducing wrinkles and fine lines I have starting in my skin. The skin on my face looks so much more supple. It also seems to keep down oiliness and shine off my face. My skin also looks clearer with less break outs and skin problems. I use the serum on clean skin of the face and I let it soak in. I also add the serum all over my face, and under the the throat and jaw line for added firmness and last I add a good moisturizing cream. While I am applying my eye makeup, I let the serums and cream soak in. The face serum contains ingredient that keep your skin smooth and moisturized.

It seems to me that the manufacturers of the product have researched and thought out the effects of this product and have provided a great combination of products to promote beautiful skin. So far no complaints or problems and all the products I've tried appear to be working very well for me.

title: This is the standard by which all other shave soaps are measured
text:
MWF was one of the first soaps I discovered early on when I returned to DE shaving, and after I figured out how to get it lathered - it’s been a great baseline to use as a comparison point to other vendor’s products. It is listed as unscented, and with the exception of a lanolin scent - it is.
Lather:
MWF is known to be difficult to lather. The trick seems to be dialing in the water amount (usually more than other shave soaps) that it needs to properly lather. However, once you’ve figured out how to dial it in for your specific water - it is easy to repeat your success in subsequent shaves. Hint – a good brush makes a WORLD of difference here… Do I want to take this camping, or use it in the field – No. Too much work to lather and uses too much water (a heavy resource to pack in). At home where I have a sink and running water - it’s fine.
Slickness:
When properly lathered, MWF is one of the slickest soaps I’ve ever used. For several years I have used it as the baseline when evaluating other shave soaps slickness. I don’t know if it’s the lanolin, or the extra amount of water required to get it lathered that makes it so slick, but by goodness it works. The best part is that when properly lathered, the slickness lasts and does not dry out too quickly. I can lather my entire face at the beginning of my shave, and not be rushed to complete it before the lather dissipates.

title: Nice improvement
text:
This is a nice improvement to the Sonicare line of brushes. It appears to be their response to the Oral-B Floss Action line of brushes that have a "paddle" to help get between teeth. This accomplishes that goal with an plastic insert in the middle that helps direct the toothpaste between your teeth.

I use both the Sonicare (Healthy White) and the Oral B 5000. Both have their pluses and minuses, so switching between the two gives me the best of both worlds.

The Oral-B arrangement of paddles does a better job in getting at the gum line without discomfort. The Sonicare Hydroclean's bristles are stiffer and I find that they irritate my gums when used several times in a row.

But, the Sonicare does a better job in cleaning stains between teeth. I'm a tea drinker and getting the stains out between my front teeth has always been a chore. The Hydroclean works very well - noticeable improvement over the Sonicare ProResults and the Oral-B.

These only come in the standard size. The ProResults has a smaller version that is great for getting at the tight spots. But, I assume that a smaller version of this would not function well since the plastic insert would have to be very small.

If you're a ProResults user these are well worth trying out. If you have tender gums you may want to alternate between the HydroClean and the ProResults (or, as I do, with the Oral-B. The Oral-B also makes a super soft brush if you have very sensitive gums. Hard to find, but works very well).

Keep in mind that nothing takes the place of flossing. No matter what you use, you still need to break out the floss to keep your teeth healthy!
